time_basis: Late on the 14th; rode in the next morning (S80 p. 148).

coordinate_basis: S80: "on the outskirts of the town": put just south-east of Pozorrubio, the side Swigert came from.
source_wording: S80 p. 148: Swigert "halted his troops on the outskirts of the town"
